description: Upload a scanner JSON report for a security scan. Pass --id, --scanner (DAST|SAST|DEPS|SECRETS), and --report-file. DAST = ZAP Traditional JSON; SAST = Semgrep CLI JSON; DEPS = Trivy JSON; SECRETS = Gitleaks JSON. Backend parses, dedupes by bug hash, and inserts new SECURITY bugs linked to the scan. Optional markCompleted=true sets the scan COMPLETED after a successful ingest; otherwise the playbook calls update-scan-progress COMPLETED.
name: report-scan-findings
title: Report Scan Findings
